summary: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting a routine quarterly distribution of $0.20 per Class I share, payable in cash or reinvested, with a record date of June 30, 2026 and payment on July 22, 2026. The filing also provided standard NAV, portfolio composition, and leverage updates as of May 31, 2026. There are no special-situation events or transactions disclosed. This is a periodic current report containing ordinary dividend declaration and portfolio statistics.
